gates.title: Embedded product, lean clients
gates.acceptance: Hindsight is used through Métis identity and surfaces. No new end-user service login, iframe admin console, desktop PostgreSQL or model weights.

gates.title: Approved inputs and canonical authority
gates.acceptance: Only eligible approved summaries/preferences/verified outcomes enter memory. Canonical records remain authoritative and model-generated observations remain labelled.

gates.title: Pre-retrieval authorization and audience
gates.acceptance: A verified principal cannot retrieve another personal/team bank, including through reflect, entities, history, listings, exports or derived pages. Mixed ACL input never reaches a model.

gates.title: No unintended retained content
gates.acceptance: Source-text and LLM traces off; external spans/queues/exports audited. Derived storage explicitly approved. No raw audio/transcript or private content in Cloudflare persistence.

gates.title: Revision-safe retain and durable projection
gates.acceptance: Stable document identity, canonical event time, CAS/fencing and metadata-only outbox survive reordered writes, restarts and ambiguous upstream acknowledgments.

gates.title: Source-linked bounded recall
gates.acceptance: Results are bounded, preserve meaning, resolve to current authorized canonical records and honor required time intervals. Unavailable is not empty.

gates.title: Grounded reflection without false authority
gates.acceptance: Syntheses name permitted sources, uncertainty and freshness; unknown lineage withholds the result. No reflection grants an action or verifies itself.

gates.title: Deletion, correction and no resurrection
gates.acceptance: Revocation blocks reads immediately; dependent observations/models/pages invalidate explicitly; pending work and restored backups cannot resurrect deleted evidence.

gates.title: Named-agent memory isolation
gates.acceptance: Personal preferences, shared team facts and agent-private experience remain distinct. Renames do not change scope, export permissions or identity.

gates.title: Actual Dust and skill interoperability
gates.acceptance: A real Dust agent and published skill retrieve/update authorized canonical records and see refreshed memory without bypassing governance.

gates.title: One accurate operational ledger
gates.acceptance: Ingestion, recall, rerank, reflection and maintenance attempts reconcile with real units and unknowns, not duplicate nested totals or content logs.

gates.title: Fast critical path and useful quality
gates.acceptance: No compulsory memory round trip for an exact open/close command. Paired multilingual evaluation measures quality and total latency/cost against existing retrieval.

gates.title: Simple, controllable UX
gates.acceptance: Memory stays inside Knowledge & skills and Intelligence. User can inspect/correct/forget, use ephemeral interaction and distinguish policy-locked controls.

gates.title: Server deployment and resilient operations
gates.acceptance: Authenticated private API and PostgreSQL, scoped secrets, version/health checks, backups, restore, workload limits and vendor failover policy are exercised.

gates.title: Incremental migration and reversible rollout
gates.acceptance: No automatic historical transcript backfill. Approved projection generations can be rebuilt/rolled back without rolling back canonical edits or revocations.

gates.title: Real cross-platform integrated proof
gates.acceptance: Windows/native Mac, deployed memory, portal, Dust and skills have explicit real proof at the claimed level. No disabled capability or fixture closes the advertised memory promise.

steps.title: Qualify the source and runtime contract
steps.implementation: Inspect the current .brain/context/wiki/recall, Operator, Dust and agent call sites. Pin the actual Hindsight release image, SDK/OpenAPI and dependencies; register license/security findings. Record the selected approved region and hosting, with no deployment claim.
steps.acceptance: Actual source map, dependency diff, API compatibility fixtures and named approval blockers.

steps.title: Approve retention and authority before ingest
steps.implementation: Define the approved derived-memory store, eligible content kinds, finite lifetimes, encryption/backup policy and canonical ownership. Exclude raw transcripts, confidential/local-only data and model-generated self-verification. Configure privacy and supplier routes in staging before synthetic customer-like data.
steps.acceptance: Reviewed data map, negative ingest matrix, live config readback and content-sentinel plan.

steps.title: Deploy the private service and database
steps.implementation: Use the existing approved container platform and managed PostgreSQL/pgvector. Pin images, mount secrets through the secret store, disable public API/DB/CP/MCP and body traces. Separate liveness from readiness, test migrations, connections, restore and restricted egress.
steps.acceptance: Identified service version/digest, private networking evidence, auth rejection, database health and restore rehearsal.

steps.title: Bind real identity and bank generation
steps.implementation: Implement Entra/authorized service principal binding and server-owned bank registry. Partition by tenant, effective security domain and ACL epoch, not guessed email or model tags. Add cross-replica fences and read-lease revocation. Inventory every upstream read/admin endpoint.
steps.acceptance: Two users/two teams/agent cases demonstrate pre-model exclusion and immediate epoch invalidation.

steps.title: Implement canonical-to-memory projection
steps.implementation: Wire the supplied transport into the real canonical service. Use metadata-only outbox references, read approved source at execution, carry event time and revision, stable document IDs, replace only, and bounded batches. Record accepted versus searchable state separately.
steps.acceptance: Concurrent updates, duplicate delivery, negative acknowledgement, crash-after-write, and read-your-write tests on the actual DB/service.

steps.title: Implement bounded recall with lineage
steps.implementation: Resolve nonempty trusted scope before recall; use strict tags and facts-only profile first. Resolve memory IDs to canonical sources with current revisions/ACLs before returning context. Preserve human names/negation and enforce hard date filters outside ranking hints.
steps.acceptance: Authorized source packets, revoked/untagged/fuzzy-scope rejection and measured low-budget queries.

steps.title: Implement correction, tombstone and purge fences
steps.implementation: Persist canonical tombstones before waiting on any in-flight writer. Revoke read leases, implement exact-document cleanup, durable reconciliation and safe generation quarantine. Build dependency tracking for future observations/models; do not wait for richer synthesis to block raw fact reads.
steps.acceptance: Real source deletion during retain/recall, duplicate/out-of-order writes, purge timeout and restored-backup tests. Rich derived-model cleanup is additionally proven in HMSTEP-10.

steps.title: Wire the memory UX into Métis
steps.implementation: Implement the provided memory review/coverage design inside existing Intelligence and Knowledge & skills. Agent threads share authorized context, not private hidden state. Include disabled, syncing, unavailable, partial, revoked and purge-pending labels. Preserve orb-only ARMED and Tony onboarding.
steps.acceptance: Actual Windows/native Mac keyboard/accessibility flows and cross-session authorized recall; no vendor dashboard or second microphone.

steps.title: Connect Dust and server skills
steps.implementation: Use the existing governed MCP/service interface rather than raw Hindsight endpoints. Dust writes through canonical mutation/proposals; skill/agent versions bind source scopes. Propagate corrected records back to memory and all readers.
steps.acceptance: Real Dust read→authorized canonical update→Métis readback→skill reuse, plus revoked audience/agent-switch tests.

steps.title: Qualify observations, mental models and derivative cleanup
steps.implementation: Add complete lineage and scoped refresh for derived observations and reviewed mental models inside homogeneous ACL banks. Wire actual create/refresh/version/failure controls through restricted service administration. Apply existing tombstone/generation fences to all derived models/pages/history and block global-sensitive directives.
steps.acceptance: Real derived answer, human correction, deletion with upstream is_stale unchanged, stale async completion and incomplete lineage all behave correctly. Only then enable the richer profile.

steps.title: Account for every memory workload
steps.implementation: Integrate each actual provider attempt and background task into the existing ledger, including embedding/reranking and optional TypeSafe/Jev reranking. Do not infer Laya compatibility. Show infrastructure allocation separately and suppress payloads/high-cardinality metrics.
steps.acceptance: Known zero versus missing, nested billing dedup, cancelled billable work, retries and full-window portal reconciliation.

steps.title: Benchmark usefulness, multilingual fidelity and speed
steps.implementation: Run held-out paired tasks against current canonical search/Graphify and Hindsight. Measure citations, temporal errors, contradictions, coverage, abstention and total cost/latency. Include Québec French, English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese; no production-recording retention for benchmarks.
steps.acceptance: Versioned permitted corpus, samples/denominators, p50/p95/p99 and a documented adoption decision; no vendor leaderboard substitution.

steps.title: Exercise failure and security boundaries
steps.implementation: Test injected memory instructions, poisoned names, global directives, missing auth, key rotation, budget exhaustion, stalled workers, lost network, replica races and provider-retention drift. Local stop and deterministic actions remain independent.
steps.acceptance: Negative test receipts, redacted diagnostics, incident and safe-rebuild runbook, zero unauthorized source disclosure in tested cases.

steps.title: Migrate with scoped canaries
steps.implementation: Inventory only eligible canonical records, preview counts/audiences, receive actual migration approval, and process resumable bounded batches. Shadow comparison cannot write twice or widen recipients. Switch projection pointer after qualification; preserve canonical revisions and tombstones.
steps.acceptance: Dry-run manifest, real canary, versioned migration state, safe rollback and optional-model/installer size regression.

steps.title: Prove the complete product journeys
steps.implementation: Run the HM-FLOW sequences with actual packaged Windows and native Mac, Hindsight, canonical backing store, qualified providers, Dust/skills and deployed Operator. Independent Fable reviews source plus evidence, not test count. Keep Apple publication hold separate.
steps.acceptance: Actual source/artifact/deployment IDs and receipts; fixture, pure transport, service smoke and product E2E results separately labelled.

steps.title: Freeze, release and operate the qualified capability
steps.implementation: Close affected regression gates after refactoring. Sign Windows, freeze exact bytes, verify the actual release/update path and enable only approved service cohorts. Native Mac engineering is tested but public signing remains gated. Monitor freshness/purge backlog and invalidation incidents.
steps.acceptance: Exact signed-artifact/service provenance, rollback ownership, telemetry-only alerting and unresolved gates honestly retained.

use_cases.title: Remember a reviewed language preference
use_cases.expected: It becomes personal memory only after canonical approval; a later authorized thread recalls its source.

use_cases.title: Recall before an account meeting
use_cases.expected: Return scoped current commitments with sources, not a reconstructed transcript.

use_cases.title: Unverified budget in a summary
use_cases.expected: Preserve provisional status and currency; do not promote an extraction to confirmed budget.

use_cases.title: Same user on two devices
use_cases.expected: Same permitted personal bank; two devices do not produce independent conflicting identities.

use_cases.title: Agent renamed
use_cases.expected: Stable ID and scope survive; the new display name never grants additional sources.

use_cases.title: Different agent with private context
use_cases.expected: Do not share private agent history unless explicitly authorized.

use_cases.title: Dust asks for permitted meeting context
use_cases.expected: Use the existing governed endpoint; return real evidence and freshness.

use_cases.title: Dust corrects a commitment
use_cases.expected: Canonical CAS then invalidation/reprojection, not direct edits in generated memory.

use_cases.title: Published skill uses memory
use_cases.expected: Version and source scope pinned; runtime respects audience and budget.

use_cases.title: Employee revoked during recall
use_cases.expected: Withhold all late results and block the scope at the trusted boundary.

use_cases.title: Source deleted during retain
use_cases.expected: In-flight write cannot publish or resurrect it; reconciliation remains pending until proved.

use_cases.title: Mental model not flagged stale after deletion
use_cases.expected: Explicit dependency invalidation hides the derived answer despite upstream flag.

use_cases.title: Out-of-order source revision
use_cases.expected: Older worker cannot replace newer projection or source.

use_cases.title: Duplicate outbox event
use_cases.expected: No duplicate retained document or duplicate usage settlement; genuine retries billed separately.

use_cases.title: Server confirms retain but search lags
use_cases.expected: Show sync pending; do not claim memory ready from HTTP 200.

use_cases.title: Memory provider unavailable
use_cases.expected: Show unavailable; exact actions still work and no-memory answer discloses missing history.

use_cases.title: User selects an ephemeral interaction
use_cases.expected: No hidden retain, feedback training or summary projection for that interaction.

use_cases.title: User selected local-only processing
use_cases.expected: Do not call remote memory, embeddings, reranker or reflection.

use_cases.title: Cloudflare gateway body logging drifts
use_cases.expected: Block affected content route; preserve operational metadata incident only.

use_cases.title: Worker payload holds approved content
use_cases.expected: Enforce finite terminal retention and explicit stuck-job cleanup; no raw transcript in task payload.

use_cases.title: Prompt injection embedded in a memory
use_cases.expected: Treat as quoted evidence; no tool, bank, policy, secret or skill permission change.

use_cases.title: Untagged and fuzzy matches
use_cases.expected: No private recall via empty or fuzzy security scope; strict matching and bank identity enforced.

use_cases.title: Mixed audience Teams meeting
use_cases.expected: Use only sources permitted to the output audience, not organizer-private context.

use_cases.title: Hard date filter
use_cases.expected: Exclude canonical records outside the requested period even if semantic recall ranks them.

use_cases.title: Multilingual proper name and negation
use_cases.expected: Preserve original text and meaning; aliases cannot merge unrelated canonical people.

use_cases.title: Embedding model changed, same dimensions
use_cases.expected: Treat as a new vector space; generation rebuild and qualification, not in-place mixing.

use_cases.title: Memory inference incurs background costs
use_cases.expected: Count actual stage attempts; no free-memory or double-counted nested-total claim.

use_cases.title: Unknown token counts
use_cases.expected: Leave missing fields null and basis visible; never invent exact totals.

use_cases.title: Privacy-safe source text disabled
use_cases.expected: Document text and raw chunk expansion unavailable; canonical authorized view provides evidence.

use_cases.title: Restore a pre-deletion backup
use_cases.expected: Tombstones/ACL epochs reapplied before serving; no resurrection.

use_cases.title: Simple “open Notes” command
use_cases.expected: No obligatory memory/reflection step; retained context never substitutes a fresh target.

use_cases.title: Final Windows and native Mac journey
use_cases.expected: Actual live retain/recall/correct/forget/portal flow on identified artifacts and services.
